syntaxDescription: One palette for all languages. Light and dark colors follow the app appearance; also applied to diffs.
keyboardScope: App shortcuts only. Mod means Command on macOS and Ctrl on Windows/Linux. Type a chord such as Mod+Shift+K. App commands such as the command palette, settings, sidebar, tools, Browser and mode switches also work while a terminal or text field has focus, so on Windows/Linux their Ctrl chords (for example Ctrl+K) no longer reach the terminal; rebind them here to give the key back. Editor editing/save keys keep their native bindings. Tab navigation shortcuts also work in terminal inputs.

errors.invalid: Use Mod/Ctrl/Alt/Shift plus one letter, digit, punctuation key Tab or F1–F12.
errors.reserved: This shortcut is reserved for editing or the system.
errors.conflict: This shortcut conflicts with another app command.
